d: Mandatory: IELTS Score of 7 and above + CELTA Certified.
To teach academic English language classes or other Key Skills programs e.g employability/health & safety.
q: Bachelor's Degree in a related field i.e. TESOL, TEFL, or Education Recognized teaching certificate i.e. CELTA IELTS 7.0 or equivalent (Bilingual only) 3 years in a teaching role, preferably in a vocational or higher education institution Experience in a technical context desirable
r: Teaching English language curriculum to SPSP trainees
Working with other team members to prepare resources for the foundation program, including, but not limited to, revision materials, test question banks, or other remedial resources
Monitoring student progress and analysing test results to address weak areas
Substituting for other faculty members in cases of absence
Following and encouraging trainees to follow SPSP rules and regulations
Preparing and implementing lesson plans and following prescribed pacing schedules for the curriculum
Willing to help others and to meet staff and student needs and is ready to follow directions
Initiative: Seeks to learn and recognise work procedures and policies and know how to locate information
Utilises and collaborates with SPSP departments, e.g. operations, support services, student affairs.
